name: ID Validator
description: Validate Chinese ID numbers, USCC codes, phone numbers, bank cards and postcodes, with normalised output.

hints.value: Validation runs entirely on the server; on failure only the reason type is returned and the input is never echoed.
hints.output: ID cards report province, date of birth and gender; USCC codes report the check character.

faq.a: No, only the 18-digit form with an optional trailing X is validated.

faq.q: Is the check digit algorithm secure?
faq.a: The check digit is a fixed-weight checksum against typing errors, not a cryptographic signature, and must not be used for authentication.
